summary: Verified Production Run wizard bug fixes for fresh pre-production checklist + cancel confirmation. Backend regression /app/backend/tests/manual_run_scoping.py PASSED all assertions (parallel runs don't see each other's ticks, QR page doesn't see run-tagged tick, cancel removes tagged records + writes audit, same-day QR tick counts, stale-batch guard 409, old untagged record ignored). Frontend Flow 1 (as CEO admin@nylaairwater.earth): initiated batch B-140926-103 with SKU Demo 500ml, wizard pre-checklist shows 'ZZ FRESH tank' UNTICKED, wizard-start-btn disabled with wizard-start-blocked text '(1 pending)'. Ticked via run-check-tick-<eqId> → start button enabled. Clicked wizard-cancel-run → wizard-cancel-dialog appeared containing batch code 'B-140926-103' AND phrase '1 pre-production check ticked in this run'. wizard-cancel-keep closes dialog and stays in wizard. Re-opened, wizard-cancel-confirm → navigated to /production-batches with toast 'Production run … discarded · 1 checklist record(s) removed'. Flow 2: initiated a new batch (same SKU) — pre-checklist shows ZZ FRESH tank NOT ticked, '0/1 done', wizard-start-btn disabled with wizard-start-blocked. Ticked, Start, entered 3 crates in wizard-crates-input, Stop → advanced to Post-Production Checklist + Create Production Batch section. Clicked wizard-cancel-run → dialog lists 'its 3 crates output', 'its start/stop times and all checklist records tied to this run'; wizard-cancel-confirm → back on /production-batches, batch card gone. Cleanup executed: cancelled 2 orphan draft batches from earlier failed script attempts (B-140926-101, B-140926-102), deleted ZZ FRESH tank equipment + its maintenance_records + audit records. Zero residual test data.
seed_data_creation: Created ZZ FRESH tank equipment (per_run_maintenance=true, no params, no sku restriction) via POST /api/production/equipment; deleted after tests. Created and cancelled 3 draft batches (B-140926-101/102/103); all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard testids in ProductionRunWizard.js: wizard-start-btn (not wizard-start), wizard-stop-btn, wizard-crates-input, wizard-cancel-run, wizard-cancel-dialog, wizard-cancel-keep, wizard-cancel-confirm, run-check-tick-<eqId>, wizard-start-blocked. Wizard URL pattern is /production-batches/<id>/run. SKU picker in Initiate dialog is a native <select>; use page.select_option(). SKU 'Demo 500ml' has value 'vgdemo-sku'.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification only. Both bug fixes verified working: (1) each fresh batch renders its pre-production checklist scoped to that batch_id so previously ticked checks (including from cancelled runs) do NOT carry over; (2) Cancel run shows a confirmation AlertDialog with batch code and stage-specific summary (mentions '1 pre-production check ticked in this run' at pre stage; 'start/stop times and all checklist records tied to this run' at post stage), and confirming discards the batch + deletes tagged maintenance_records + writes production_run_cancelled audit.
